rationale: The four views consistently show a low, broad podium supporting a smaller rectangular upper bar, so the massing is coherent across views and does not visibly collide. However, the upper element reads more as a short bar than a convincingly slender tower, weakening the stated podium-to-tower gesture. The shallow offsets and side slabs create limited undercut or courtyard logic, while the overall form has some resonance with podium-and-upper-mass precedents but little of their stronger sectional or terraced character.
warnings: The primary upper mass is too short and broad to read strongly as a slender tower.
The apparent void/undercut is shallow and mostly reads as an edge offset rather than a meaningful public void.
Side podium pieces slightly dilute the main massing relationship.
